rationale: The description meaningfully specifies conventional data joining, analysis, visualization, profile unification and behavior-based journey personalization; it does not establish an AI mechanism.
evidence_spans: join all of your data from every channel into a single interface for real-time, omnichannel analysis and visualization
Collect, normalize and unify all known and unknown individual data and company data into robust, real-time people and account profiles
allows you tailor individual journeys for every customer based on their previous behavior and preferences
conflict_response: The labeler treats per-customer tailoring from prior behavior as unresolved, while the blind proposal identifies the stated conventional data, profile and journey functions. The parent concern is addressed by not claiming whether tailoring uses rules or learned models: the source gives no AI signal and describes personalization based on stated behavior and preferences alongside ordinary data operations. That possible implementation uncertainty does not by itself outweigh the meaningful conventional offering, so the negative is supported.
